data.description: Bring intention and artistry to your space with our Speckled Ceramic Incense and Crystal Holder. Handcrafted with a smooth, minimalist silhouette and finished with delicate speckled detailing, this piece blends modern design with earthy charm. Designed to hold incense sticks securely while also offering a dedicated space for your favorite crystals, it’s perfect for meditation, rituals, or everyday moments of calm. The ceramic surface is heat-safe and easy to clean, making it as practical as it is beautiful. Whether styled on an altar, bedside table, or shelf, this versatile holder adds a grounding, serene touch to any room—inviting balance, mindfulness, and quiet elegance into your daily routine. Dimensions: 5" x 1.25" Incense and crystals not included.
